summary.intent: Remove or correct outdated production environment references in CONCERNS.md, since production does not yet exist and staging is the only deployed environment.
summary.outcome: 6 production references in CONCERNS.md were updated to reflect staging as the current deployed environment, with production reframed as future/speculative where appropriate.

repo: The project has staging as the only deployed environment; production does not yet exist.
ENVIRONMENTS.md contained outdated information that had propagated incorrect assumptions into CONCERNS.md.
The term 'production code' is used in two senses in CONCERNS.md: (1) the production environment, and (2) non-POC/non-test code — these must be distinguished when editing.

code.finding: Debug log leakage concern was scoped to 'production' but should reference 'staging' as the actual deployed env.
Docker network isolation concern referenced 'staging/production'; production does not exist yet.
CI/CD secret management concern was written as if production exists; reworded to future-tense.
Claimed production relies on delegated-ipfs.dev, but this is a plan not yet reality.
Block described production use of delegated-ipfs.dev and deploying Someguy to production — neither exists yet.
Observability concern referenced production; updated to cover staging and any future deployed environment.
'Production web code' left unchanged — means non-dev code, not the production environment.
'Alongside production code' left unchanged — means non-POC code, not the production environment.

workflow: Planning docs (CONCERNS.md, ENVIRONMENTS.md) can drift out of sync as project state evolves; periodic audits against current environment reality are worthwhile.

open_items: ENVIRONMENTS.md may still contain outdated information about production that should be reviewed and corrected.
Production environment setup is deferred; concerns marked as future/speculative will need revisiting when production is established.
